pages.text: The ostrich is livestock that can outrun a horse and disagrees with being livestock. It dresses out into $(item)Raw Ostrich$() — treat it like raw chicken, including the part where eating it raw is a mistake.

Sometimes an ostrich leaves behind an $(item)Ostrich Egg$() the size of your head. One egg, some butter, some cheese: the $(item)Ostrich Egg Omelette$() feeds a family. Cassowaries, meanwhile, provide the drumsticks.

Frogs finally drop $(item)Raw Frog Legs$() — the most respectable delicacy in this entire book. Butter them into a $(l:orespawn_delight:the_kitchen/salads_and_sears)Frog Leg Platter$() and pretend you run a bistro.
